scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection consists of various materials produced by the Yale Center for British Art from 1965 to the present. The materials include calendars, event materials, exhibition booklets, educational pamphlets, and visitor guides, as well as documentation of YCBA publications and programs. "Calendars" documents the history of the Center through its regularly-printed calendar of events and exhibitions. "Events" contains invitations and programs for lectures, symposia, dinners, and other events. "Exhibitions" contains material published in relation to exhibitions, including brochures, informational booklets, and programs for events held in connection with exhibitions. Through these materials, the collection provides a record of the museum's activities and development from its conception to the present.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: This collection is open without restriction. Parts of this collection are stored offsite; it may take 3 to 5 business days to retrieve offsite materials once a request has been made.
